top_signals.title: Netflix Eyes Sports to Drive Growth
top_signals.summary: Netflix's sales growth is slowing, and investors want to know what comes next. Matthew Condon of Citizens says the path forward may depend on stronger prestige programming, culturally resonant hits and a bigger role for live sports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: EQT Warns of Hidden Portfolio Risks
top_signals.summary: EQT says portfolios that look diversified may still be exposed to the same underlying risks, including AI spending. CEO Per Franzen joins Bloomberg Open Interest to discuss potential overinvestment, strong demand for data-center capacity and how higher capital costs are shaping the buildout. He also weighs in on private-equity deal flow and returning cash to investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Empires of AI
top_signals.summary: In this essay, Niall Ferguson, one of the world’s foremost experts on imperial history, teams up the former CEO of Google, Eric Schmidt, and the researcher Lisa Klaassen to make the provocative argument that AI is an inherently “imperial technology”—and to reveal what the fate of past empires might say about the future of U.S.-Chinese competition in a world shaped by AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
